brand.name: AMED IA
brand.description: Intelligent platform for nursing professionals using Generative AI for clinical and community simulations.

theme.rationale: Medical and educational tools require trust, clarity, and calm. We avoid the typical 'cold hospital blue' and instead use grounded, organic tones (Warm Bone, Deep Slate, Clay) that feel human-centric and empathetic, crucial for community nursing.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing & Control Room Density. Dashboards use tight bento grids, while learning spaces breathe.
layout_and_spacing.grid_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 items-start

surface_strategies.cards: Flat solid background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), NO default shadow. On hover: shadow-sm and -translate-y-[2px].
surface_strategies.chat_interface: No chat bubbles. Editor-style conversation stream. Left border colors to differentiate AI vs Student.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid background (bg-white) with a hard 1px bottom border to separate from content. No glassmorphism in clinical tools to prevent visual refraction.

components_instructions.buttons: Rounded-md (radius 6px). Primary actions use Brand Accent (#C47055). Secondary actions use Outline. Provide clear focus rings.
components_instructions.inputs: Shadcn defaults customized with 1px border, flat white background, subtle focus ring (ring-[#1A2B3C]).
components_instructions.tables: Shadcn tables. High data density. Use alternating row colors for readability if rows exceed 10.
components_instructions.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Use monochromatic scales of Deep Slate for IDEC metrics, and Warm Clay for PICE progression to maintain elegant palette.
components_instructions.simulation_chat: Three-pane layout: Left (Patient Vitals/Context 3 cols), Center (Chat Stream 6 cols), Right (Live Competency/Rubric 3 cols).

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements must change state. Buttons darken. Cards lift slightly.
motion_and_interaction.loading: Use skeleton screens (animate-pulse) with the surface color slightly darkened. Avoid generic spinners for heavy data.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight depending on context. Keep uniform.

logos.description: Medical university emblem for dashboard header

backgrounds.description: Clean, bright, modern hospital background for login or landing page hero.

simulation_context.description: Used as contextual thumbnails inside the clinical simulation patient profiles.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Javascript (.js) for all React files, not TypeScript (.tsx).
Follow the layout grid strategies strictly. Use bento-grid for the dashboards.
Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Tables, Select, Dialogs) but strip Vercel-look borders and apply our flat surface strategy.
Implement Recharts for IDEC and PICE metrics.
Do NOT use typical message bubbles for the AI chat. Use a seamless, full-width stream where messages are separated by padding and subtle borders, similar to an IDE terminal or Notion document.
Integrate Phosphor icons as the primary icon set.
All interactive elements and metrics MUST use data-testid attributes.
